# Token Horizon

> Local AI usage and observability across coding tools, cloud providers and local models. Native macOS notch and desktop widgets, a public model catalog, and optional community sharing.

The local engine is the source of truth for usage. Token counts come from provider-reported data, not estimates. Model prices are catalog evidence; free, subscription-covered and unpriced models are distinct states. Public profiles contain only data the owner has chosen to publish. Private prompts and local traces stay on the user's device.

## Product and guides

- [Token Horizon](https://token-horizon.dev/): Features and installation.
- [Documentation](https://token-horizon.dev/docs/): Setup, data rules, local HTTP API, MCP and gateway.
- [Engineering blog](https://token-horizon.dev/blog/): Product and engineering notes.
- [Why Token Horizon exists](https://token-horizon.dev/blog/why-token-horizon.html): Local-first usage tracking and honest model evidence.
- [Why zero isn't zero](https://token-horizon.dev/blog/pricing-evidence.html): Free, plan-covered and unpriced catalog entries.

## Public discovery

- [Community leaderboard](https://token-horizon.dev/leaderboard): Published usage, activity and league progress.
- [Community teams](https://token-horizon.dev/leaderboard?view=teams): Published team activity and rankings.
- [Usage leagues](https://token-horizon.dev/leaderboard?view=leagues): The seven leagues and community progress.
- [Model explorer](https://token-horizon.dev/models): Models, capabilities, context and pricing.
- [Cheapest model listings](https://token-horizon.dev/models?tab=cheapest): Price comparisons derived from the exported catalog.
- [Model providers](https://token-horizon.dev/models?tab=providers): Serving providers and their listings.
- [Subscription plans](https://token-horizon.dev/models?tab=plans): Curated plans and covered models.

## Integrations and source

- [Source and README](https://github.com/castlemilk/token-horizon): Architecture, installation and API usage.
- [Public MCP endpoint](https://token-horizon.dev/mcp/public): Read-only model and public community tools over Streamable HTTP.

Individual account management, team invitations and shared report links are not public documentation. Never infer access to private reports or undisclosed user data from a public profile.
